open_points.subject: _validate_initial_allocations
open_points.other_text: - _validate_initial_allocations: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST raise FinancialValidationError for a SECTION instruction without section_id, an OTHER_EXPENSES instruction carrying a section_id, any other target, and an allocation total that differs from intake.total_amount, all before opening any transaction; it MUST then open exactly one transaction, resolve every SECTION target only through tx.project_sections().get_project_section with intake.project_id and section_id, and close that read transaction by exactly one rollback, marking it closed before it raises ExpenseValidationError for a missing or cross-project section so that rejection keeps the 422 status the legacy BudgetValidationError produced; it MUST NOT call validate_project_section, a PortalStore lookup, or a legacy PortalTransaction project-section method.
open_points.question: Which passage must change: must PortalStore declare a transaction-opening operation, or must _validate_initial_allocations not be required to open a transaction?

open_points.subject: create_expense_from_recognition
open_points.other_text: - create_expense_from_recognition: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open exactly one transaction after allocation validation completes, read the replay candidate only through tx.expenses().get_expense_by_recognition_id with intake.recognized_document_id, insert the new aggregate only through tx.expenses().insert_expense_aggregate, append the audit only through tx.audit(), and call no legacy PortalTransaction expense method.
open_points.question: Which passage must change: must PortalStore declare a transaction-opening operation, or must create_expense_from_recognition not be required to open a transaction?
